items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: and I was with Conrad Janis, who had the group up there.

ctx.x: I had the pleasure of working with Zutty Singleton at the Central Plaza on Second Avenue and 6th Street for 10 years; I was like the house drummer up
there, and Zutty Singleton was the other house drummer, because they used to have two bands up there and each of them played a half hour set, and I was with Conrad Janis, who had the group up there.
Yeah, he played with them -- a trombone player.
